observed: AutomationService accepts an injected headless dispatcher, persists dispatching before launch, and honors execution gates for scheduled/RPC work. main/index.ts injects the dispatcher only in serve mode; a desktop without a ready window and without this dispatcher skips launch.
The terminal production launcher forks detached, waits up to 10 seconds for readiness, then unrefs/disconnects. This is terminal hosting, not a persistent job claim/heartbeat supervisor.

SSH relay reconnect rebuilds provider state; the configured grace governs retained PTYs. Current default grace is 0, meaning until reset/no timer, not immediate expiration. Empty detached startup is separately bounded. Relay disposal kills hosted PTYs; survival through disconnect does not prove survival through relay/service/host restart.

Daemon PID metadata includes pid and startedAtMs, but startTimeMatches permits missing expected or actual start time. That permissive daemon check is insufficient for worker restart/cancellation authority.
required: One enrolled background worker supervisor per laptop/VPS device, independent of any app window, owns job slots and local attempt journals. The VPS authoritative queue is not copied to or written over a shared filesystem by workers.

A launchd/systemd service contract must specify stable executable/source identity, private state directory, service UID, restart backoff, single-instance lock, bounded logs and resource limits. C04 monitor templates are not C05 worker templates. New dobius/config/scripts/workstation-worker/ does not yet exist and needs explicit ROOT ownership before implementation.

Persist launch intent before spawning; persist attemptId, workerId, worker incarnation/boot identity, PID plus non-null process start identity, process group or cgroup/job object, stable PTY/session handle, profile ID, root/worktree identity, source revision, recipe/policy version and checkpoint/log cursor. Seal lease tokens in private worker state; never include their values in logs or artifacts.

After restart or reconnect, reconcile server lease and actual process identity before a new claim. Unknown identity blocks launch and destructive signals. Sleep/offline makes capacity stale; reconnect resumes observation of the existing attempt and never blindly reruns its command.

Use OS-enforced descendant containment for Linux jobs and a verified macOS process-group/descendant strategy with no untracked detach. Windows job containment is a separate unsupported gate until verified. Service shutdown/restart must define whether owned children stop or remain recoverable; no implicit orphaning.

observed: C02 claim checks persistent dispatch pause, matching device/capability/recipe, completed dependencies, safe-integer capacity, <=90-second-old sample, and one live/stopping/interrupted attempt per worker ID. reservedBytes is supplied by the caller; no durable per-device/per-volume reservation ledger is present.

C04 samples/decisions use Unix seconds, a default 180-second freshness limit with five-second future tolerance, hysteresis and a critical reserve. C02 sampledAt is milliseconds, rejects any future timestamp and uses a 90-second maximum. C02 does not consume C04 health or critical hysteresis directly.

The generic execution gate is a separate persisted crew pause. The agents-page origin bypasses that gate; normal scheduled/RPC calls use agent-run. dispatch-build additionally contacts the existing ADAM handshake. This is compatibility evidence, not authorization to activate ADAM or the historical queue.

required: Bind worker identity/device/capabilities to authenticated enrollment, not request-supplied strings. Authorize submit/claim/heartbeat/settle/cancel/review separately. Unknown, offline or revoked workers cannot claim.

Convert C04 seconds to validated safe-integer milliseconds without replacing the sampling timestamp. Map OS darwin to the schema capability macos and explicitly define portable-recipe eligibility.

Reserve estimated working bytes, all concurrent attempt reservations, safety margin and critical reserve atomically by device plus verified physical storage pool. Three profile worker IDs must share the device budget. Release reservations only after verified process cleanup/result finalization; unknown estimates use the conservative C04 default before building a CloudJobInput.

Start with one heavy build per physical device; three profiles allow three isolated small jobs only within measured CPU/RAM/disk/provider budgets. Publish timestamped free RAM/CPU/load, monitor age and estimated-versus-actual spend; define wall-time, output, attempt/model-call and cost limits.

Check pause/revocation, current lease, root identity, recipe authority and fresh capacity immediately before spawn and after every awaited setup step. Apple signing/iOS jobs require an explicitly verified Mac capability. An operator queuing from phone is not the agents-page pause bypass.
